name: Pretty Devil Millium to Issho -Aku Chuunyuu After-
original_name: PrettyDevilミリオムといっしょ －悪注入アフター－
source:
Pretty Devil Millium finally leaves for at least 60 years, and main character has to spend this winter without his libido satisfied. He notices some activity in the garbage big and pokes its contents with a stick. To his surprise a precious person crawls from there... his precious devil.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
可爱恶魔密里欧姆终于离开了，至少要离开60年，主人公不得不在性欲得不到满足的情况下度过这个冬天。他注意到垃圾袋里有动静，便用棍子戳了戳里面的东西。令他惊讶的是，一个珍贵的人从里面爬了出来……他珍贵的恶魔。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
